description: Live Vertex quota-allocation burst runs for TASK-F03 (FR-08, ADR 0009 Open Item 2). scripts/vertex_quota_burst_test.py drives steady Tier-2 demand and bursty signature-synthesis demand against the paid gemini-3.5-flash-lite quota (location=global, ~300 RPM), exercising the production TokenBucketRateLimiter and the constants from blackwall.sync_resolver. Each policy ran after a 65s quiet window to get a fresh provider minute. The shipped policy is 'reserved' (rate-partition: 60 RPM Tier-2 share + 240 RPM synthesis share); 'uncoordinated' and 'shared' are comparison baselines. Run with --out to add a new file, then list it here and keep tests/unit/test_vertex_quota_burst_data.py green. No project id or credentials are recorded in any file.

runs.purpose: Re-run that validated the shipped rate-partition after the PR #212 Greptile fixes: Tier-2 429 was 11/40 uncoordinated, 10/40 with one shared bucket, and 0/40 partitioned (synthesis 92 ok, 36 graceful skips, 0 429). Figures are transcribed from the console output; the script gained --out in the follow-up commit.

discarded.what: Two 2026-11-19 attempts in which every call errored (0 ok, 0 429; ClientError 403 CONSUMER_INVALID) before any measurement was taken.
discarded.why: The Google Cloud project variable in .env is quoted; extracting it with a shell cut passed the literal quotes into the client, so Vertex rejected every request. The script now fails loudly when a caller receives no Vertex responses, and this directory records the invalid run instead of silently dropping it.
